title: Input Bias Correction in Gaussian Process Regression
abstract: arXiv:2610.31920v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In traditional Gaussian process (GP) regression, the inputs are typically assumed to be known, and uncertainty enters only through the measurements. When scalar fields are mapped using GP regression with measurements obtained from a mobile sensor, the inputs correspond to the estimated pose of the mobile sensor. The goal in this letter is to understand how a recorded GP, trained on erroneous inputs (e.g., pose estimates from dead-reckoning), can be corrected in a numerically efficient way when better estimates of the inputs become available. In the developed bias-aware GP (Ba-GP) framework, the recorded GP posterior-mean gradient is used to propagate estimated input bias and noise into mean and covariance corrections. The resulting additive covariance structure is then exploited to develop numerically efficient first-order correction algorithms. translated_title: 高斯过程回归中的输入偏差校正
translated_abstract: 在传统的高斯过程回归中，输入通常被假定为已知的，不确定性仅通过测量值引入。当使用高斯过程回归并利用移动传感器获取的测量值来映射标量场时，输入对应于移动传感器的估计位姿。本简报的目标是研究当更好的输入估计可用时，如何以数值高效的方式校正基于错误输入（例如来自航位推算的位姿估计）训练的已记录高斯过程。在所开发的偏差感知高斯过程（Ba-GP）框架中，利用已记录高斯过程的后验均值梯度，将估计的输入偏差和噪声传播为均值和协方差校正。随后利用所得到的加性协方差结构，开发了数值高效的一阶校正算法。仿真研究和室内光照强度映射实验表明，Ba-GP 提升了……
tldr: 提出偏差感知高斯过程（Ba-GP）框架，利用已记录GP的后验均值梯度将输入偏差和噪声传播为均值与协方差校正，并借助加性协方差结构开发数值高效的一阶校正算法，从而在获得更优输入估计时高效修正基于错误输入训练的高斯过程模型。
en_tdlr: Proposes a bias-aware Gaussian process (Ba-GP) framework that uses the recorded GP posterior-mean gradient to propagate input bias and noise into mean and covariance corrections, exploiting an additive covariance structure to develop numerically efficient first-order correction algorithms for updating GP models trained on erroneous inputs.
